name: seat-chart
title: Seat Chart
description: How an assembly divides its seats: a half-circle of dots, one per seat, filled group by group from left to right. It answers the question a results table cannot answer at a glance: who holds the room, and how far the largest group is from a majority.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/seat-chart

Installed to `components/ui/charts/seat-chart.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/charts/seat-chart';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/seat-chart

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
